purpose: Strengthen the post-Stage1 Pythonless proof from observed non-access to kernel-enforced filesystem inaccessibility while preserving Python only as an external orchestrator.

artifact_precondition.reason: The Stage compiler and stage1_host_io.c require only their own mapped code/data plus stdin/stdout/stderr syscalls. A dynamic loader would require filesystem reads after the sandbox is installed.

kernel_filesystem_proof.mechanism: Linux Landlock path-beneath ruleset installed by a small host launcher immediately before execve of the compiler
kernel_filesystem_proof.required_replay: sandboxed compiler assembly SHA256 and bytes must equal the assembly used to construct the measured next-stage artifact

independent_process_trace.mechanism: direct strace proof remains separate from the Landlock replay
independent_process_trace.reason: Landlock prevents filesystem-backed Python/bootstrap delegation; strace independently proves the compiler did not spawn/exec descendants or attempt forbidden file paths.

compiler_syscall_boundary.python_or_shell_exec_under_landlock: kernel denied because no other executable path is permitted

full_self_hosting_rule: Stage1/Stage2 artifacts satisfy freestanding ELF gate
Landlock sandbox replay passes for Stage1->Stage2 and Stage2->Stage3
sandboxed assembly equals the corresponding measured build assembly
Stage2 and Stage3 ELF bytes/SHA256 are exactly equal
prohibited: calling absence of observed file opens equivalent to inaccessible filesystem
allowing the repository root or bootstrap as a Landlock read path
allowing /usr/bin/python or a Python runtime path
falling back to unsandboxed execution when Landlock is unavailable
using Docker as a required dependency
using the Landlock host launcher as code generation or semantic compilation
